explanation: XOR all array entries with every integer in 1..n. All required single occurrences cancel, leaving the extra occurrence.
correctness: Every required integer appears once in each XOR group and cancels. The duplicated integer has one unmatched extra occurrence.
walkthrough: XOR [3,1,4,2,3] with the required range [1,2,3,4]. One occurrence of every required key cancels, leaving the extra 3. No overflowing arithmetic sum is formed.
